subject: Alignment and transfer of data into data items
notes: kb/Work PB77 (2026-08-18): a fixed-point numeric receiver takes the sending value aligned by decimal point 'with zero fill or truncation on either end' — for EVERY sending magnitude, including one past the Int128 carrier. Every carrier's landing now has two forms chosen by the LANDING: the CHECKED landing (ON SIZE ERROR / EC-SIZE) saturates so the capacity check raises (PB13); the UNCHECKED landing (MOVE, the no-phrase store, INVOKE BY CONTENT) keeps the low-order digits — the native exact family through CobolNum.RescaleStoreCap, the float family through the exact binary64 expansion (CobolFloat.LowOrderDigits) — where before both saturated and the MOVE stored the sentinel's low digits (MOVE FUNCTION NUMVAL-F("5E+30") TO PIC V9(9) stored 884105727 for 000000000). The SDIDI carrier had the two forms since PB74. In-carrier MOVEs are unchanged. retired-witness: unit:CarrierLandingFormTests.ToScaled_PastTheCarrier_SaturatesChecked_LandsLowOrderDigitsUnchecked (renamed by kb/Work PB2967 (train 1059) when the checked landing began to raise past the carrier; the same test, which still pins the unchecked low-order-digits MOVE landing, is re-named above) retired-witness: unit:CarrierLandingFormTests.ToScaled_PastTheCarrier_RaisesChecked_SaturatesIntermediate_LandsLowOrderDigitsUnchecked (renamed by kb/Work PB3019 (w1069a) when the intermediate (binary64 -> Int128) landing began to raise EC-SIZE-OVERFLOW past the carrier instead of saturating; the same test, which still pins the unchecked low-order-digits MOVE landing, is re-named above) retired-witness: src/WiseOwl.Cobol.Runtime/Intrinsics/CobolIntrinsics.Exact.cs#Rescaled (kb/Work PB3839 deleted CobolIntrinsics.Rescaled with the last Int128 NUMVAL-F body: NUMVAL, NUMVAL-C and NUMVAL-F are all SDIDI functions now (IntrinsicCarrierRules.ReturnsExactParse), and the Int128 landing helper had no other caller; the test is the same test renamed NumvalFamily_PastTheCarrier_IsTheExactValue_WithNoLanding, which now pins that the family has no landing form to choose) retired-witness: unit:CarrierLandingFormTests.NumvalFamily_PastTheCarrier_FollowsTheLanding (kb/Work PB3839 deleted CobolIntrinsics.Rescaled with the last Int128 NUMVAL-F body: NUMVAL, NUMVAL-C and NUMVAL-F are all SDIDI functions now (IntrinsicCarrierRules.ReturnsExactParse), and the Int128 landing helper had no other caller; the test is the same test renamed NumvalFamily_PastTheCarrier_IsTheExactValue_WithNoLanding, which now pins that the family has no landing form to choose)
